fact: The Ministry of Housing and Lands says the whole land transaction process has been computerized in an integrated LAVIMS system, with the Cadastre Unit fully operational since April 2012.

LAVIMS links a digital cadastral database, a valuation of all residential and commercial sites and a parcel-based deeds registration system, and the Cadastre Unit links registered deeds to digital cadastre parcels.

The Registrar-General's Department says deeds of sale, mortgages and discharges and leases are submitted, tracked and registered online through the Mauritius eRegistry System (MeRS), or at the counter.
The Registrar-General's Department says registration duty is paid online through MeRS once the system calculates the amount payable, with penalties calculated automatically by MeRS.
